methods.title: Normalize and specialize at ownership boundaries
methods.reason: Cold layout/geometry dispatch exists; caller facts and history admission debt remain.

methods.title: Keep hot feedback stable and bounded
methods.reason: Candidate bodies observed; complete feedback/tier coverage not proved.

methods.title: Keep object shapes stable when objects are the right representation
methods.reason: Stable retained objects; no repeated reshaping found, all-tier realization incomplete.

methods.title: Prefer scalars for small ephemeral fixed tuples
methods.reason: Rank frames/scalars preserve values needed after descendant scratch reuse.

methods.title: Use indexed records for large fixed-schema populations
methods.reason: Fixed indexed TT records and typed state arenas; packing qualified at enclosing solve.

methods.title: Use semantic coordinates for identity; use addresses only for lookup
methods.reason: Addresses narrow lookup; exact encoded coordinates still determine equality.

methods.title: Precompute small immutable relations
methods.reason: Support/closure/reflection/cell-incidence tables cold, bounded and reused.

methods.title: Use exact hash indexes, never hash identity
methods.reason: Exact partial-key reconstruction and collision/alias controls; no hash-only equality.

methods.title: Preserve useful numeric representation; do not cargo-cult signedness tricks
methods.reason: M1/M2 emitted numeric boxing; any signed/window trick needs ABI proof and full-solve evidence.

methods.title: Choose Array, TypedArray, and Buffer by representation contract
methods.reason: Fixed-width/shared representation is load-bearing, not typed-array folklore.

methods.title: Eliminate repeated allocation only when the aggregate is unnecessary
methods.reason: No source temporary aggregates in recurrence; numeric engine allocation separately recorded.

methods.title: Pool only resources with a real reusable lifetime
methods.reason: Prepared one-shot resource ownership; no arbitrary pooling, closed-app retention unresolved.

methods.title: Prepare and seal capacity when hot growth is not semantic
methods.reason: Capacities sealed before recursive execution, budget fallback explicit.

methods.title: Make arena reuse generation-safe
methods.reason: No queued generation-bearing arena references; TT replacement uses exact-key/sequence protocol instead.

methods.title: Construct derived facts once at the best owner
methods.reason: Prepared plans and C34 reuse retained; extraction/repacking debt remains.

methods.title: Never materialize structure to rediscover structure
methods.reason: No hot serialization/reparsing to rediscover structured state.

methods.title: Split fast and slow paths by proven frequency/semantics
methods.reason: Terminal and tactical gates exist; eager child preparation still bypassable in principle.

methods.title: Consume exact simplifying facts before general transforms
methods.reason: D5 eager products can precede exact child/cache simplification.

methods.title: Choose iteration by required work, not syntax folklore
methods.reason: Hot indexed loops and bit scans; cold iterators not rewritten from syntax folklore.

methods.title: Keep hot signatures and code size specialization-friendly
methods.reason: Dead slot/tail ABI emitted; large bodies still retain costly calls.

methods.title: Control closure and lexical-environment creation
methods.reason: Worker helpers prepared at module/setup boundary; no closure per node found.

methods.title: Split validation from trusted internal primitives only with provenance
methods.reason: Do not globally remove proof guards; admitted specialized preconditions need caller provenance.

methods.title: Prefer mutate/undo to clone/replay for local reversible search
methods.reason: Preallocated rank frames avoid deep clones; incremental make/unmake remains unqualified alternative.

methods.title: Collapse deterministic outdegree-one execution before scheduling
methods.reason: Forced moves directly recurse without central scheduling; further transition fusion remains D10.

methods.title: Use the narrowest priority structure that expresses the policy
methods.reason: No interworker priority heap/queue in selected independent deep-worker runtime.

methods.title: Represent high-frequency shared claims as explicit numeric state
methods.reason: Explicit numeric ready/stop/done/winner state, no object claim transport.

methods.title: Design the synchronization protocol before minimizing Atomics
methods.reason: Atomic sequence/payload protocol retained before any attempt to remove synchronization.

methods.title: Design shared layout for coherence traffic, not just byte count
methods.reason: Interleaved layout/compact rows qualified, current coherence traffic and contention frequency unmeasured.

methods.title: Reuse worker threads; tune task granularity and queue pressure
methods.reason: Workers instantiated once before search; no child-created workers. One-shot session contract explicit.

methods.title: Make worker transport ownership explicit
methods.reason: Shared geometry/root/cache ownership and rank-local private scratch explicit; no escaping borrowed Buffer.

methods.title: Choose native/WASM/FFI by boundary economics
methods.reason: FFI only cold OS affinity/discovery; no hot native solver substitution.

methods.title: Prefer Node-API for stable native addons
methods.reason: No compiled Node-API addon in solver; OS FFI is a separately constrained cold mechanism.

methods.title: Use V8 Fast API only with fast-path admission proof
methods.reason: No custom V8 Fast API solver callback; generic experimental FFI only.

methods.title: Treat node:ffi as experimental unsafe execution machinery
methods.reason: Exact OS calls and cold lifetime inspected; complete ABI/permission/failure profile across all deployment platforms not recertified here.

methods.title: Keep diagnostics off the success-frequency path
methods.reason: No hot reporting counters; bounded external runtime tracing labels its perturbation.

methods.title: Choose the cheapest introspection API that satisfies the question
methods.reason: RSS external; main heap snapshots explicitly exclude workers, collected only for diagnostic ownership question.

methods.title: Lay out hot data for working-set locality

methods.title: Specialize only after semantic narrowing
methods.reason: Admitted geometry specializations retained; repeated CPC/caller facts still need shared ownership proof.

methods.title: Remove obsolete work before optimizing it
methods.reason: C24/C44/C66 supersession and current load-bearing full hash preserved; obsolete passes not restored.

methods.title: Prefer an existing optimized builtin until a narrower method is admitted
methods.reason: No folklore replacement of builtin primitives.

methods.title: Derive exact size, allocate once, write once

methods.title: Compile stable structure once when repeated interpretation is the cost

methods.title: Attack unavoidable product/materialization boundaries before subdominant work
methods.reason: Tiny result materialization E3 does not justify moving fine-grained arithmetic across native boundary.

methods.title: Keep every engine trick attached to a realization record

methods.title: Perform a maximal-effort hot-path cost audit

methods.title: Optimize critical-path cycles, not a single proxy metric

methods.title: Establish the governing optimization unit before local rewrites

methods.title: Qualify composite optimizations as composite units

methods.title: Map the regression surface before promotion
